summary: Feed s067_single to NDR is degraded due to high encrypted traffic share (92.6% vs 90% tolerance). No duplicates, drops, overload, one-way, or VLAN issues detected. Decryption visibility needed to restore NDR detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: 93% of bytes are TLS-encrypted, exceeding the NDR's 90% tolerance. Traffic is likely traversing a TLS inspection bypass or direct internet edge without broker-based decryption, so payload is opaque to the tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload for deep packet inspection, JA3/JA3S, and anomaly detection. With 92.6% encrypted, signatures, payload analytics, and lateral movement detection are blinded, significantly reducing detection coverage despite healthy delivery (no drops/overload).

recommended_fix.why: NDR needs cleartext payload and tolerates max 90% encrypted; current 92.6% exceeds it. Adding selective TLS decryption (or forwarding session keys / integrating with existing TLS visibility appliance) at the packet broker will restore payload visibility without overloading the 10G NDR port.
